title: Archaeology RadiocarbonSiteChronology

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed archaeological chronology research task for Huangtupo site. Analyzed 8 radiocarbon assays: converted F14 ratios to conventional ages (BP), implemented simplified calibration to calendar years, conducted stratigraphic analysis revealing inconsistencies in Trench 3, and developed cultural periodization framework. Generated 6 visualizations and comprehensive research report with methodology, results, and discussion. All deliverables completed: code in code/, outputs in outputs/, report in report/report.md with figures in report/images/.
